communityActivitySubtitle: Recent reviews and ratings from across the community. Discovery here happens through people, not an algorithm.
feedPreviewEmpty: No recent activity from people you follow yet.
onboardingDescription: Follow other people to see what they're listening to, rating, and commenting on here.

anonSubtagline: Log every listen with zero friction, rate it with stars and a score if you want, and follow other listeners to discover what they're spinning.
howItWorksStep1Body: Every listen goes into your diary without asking for a verdict. Rating and commenting are separate, always-optional layers.
howItWorksStep2Body: Half-stars from 0.5 to 5 plus an optional 1 to 100 score. An expression of identity, not an objective average.
howItWorksStep3Body: You choose who to follow and see what they listen to, rate, and comment on. Discovery through people, never an algorithm.
anonClosingTitle: Your listening history starts with an account.
